name: Level Shaders Fix (Render Scale)
description: Experimental scene render scaling and pixelation correction for GD 2.2081.

native-resolution.name: Lock native scene resolution
native-resolution.description: Use GD's current native framebuffer scale. Overrides the scene render percentage; window resizing remains managed by GD. Authored pixelation effects remain. Applies live.

target-60.name: Target 60 FPS
target-60.description: Request a 60 FPS render interval at startup and through native FPS updates. Cannot guarantee steady FPS on demanding levels; VSync, display timing and other mods may affect pacing. Applies live.

render-percent.name: Scene render scale (%)
render-percent.description: 100 = native quality. Lower values soften the scene and may reduce GPU scene-rendering work when level shaders are active. Pixelation triggers take priority. Applies after saving, on the next shader update.

smooth-upscale.name: Smooth upscale
smooth-upscale.description: Use texture filtering for the lower-resolution scene. Only affects render scales below 100%. Applies after saving, on the next shader update.

fix-pixelation.name: Correct pixelation grid
fix-pixelation.description: Fit whole pixelation cells and align the snap grid. Level pixelation takes priority over scene render scaling. Applies after saving, on the next shader update.

cpu-diagnostics.name: CPU timing diagnostics
cpu-diagnostics.description: Log gameplay update, visibility, particle and shader-calculation CPU timings every five seconds. Helps investigate heavy levels. Adds measurement overhead while enabled; does not measure GPU time or directly boost FPS.
